content: Okuyâkira e Mîsiri
Okubundi abarhambo b’engabo z’abalwî, aligi Yohanâni, mugala wa Karea, Azariya, mugala wa Hoshaya. n’olubaga lwoshi, abarho n’abakulu,

bayishibwîra omulêbi Yeremiyahu, erhi: «oyumvîrhize omusengero gwîrhu. Osengerêre ogûla musigala gw’olubaga emwa Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wâwe, bulyâla rhusigîre banyi bwenêne n’obwo rhwàli banji, nâwe wêne obwîne n’amasù gâwe.
Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wâwe arhuyêreke njira ehi rhugwâsirwe rhushimbe, - bici rhugwâsirwe rhujire».
Yeremiyahu, mulêbi, ashuza, erhi: «Nyumvîrhe, nkolaga nashenga Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wîrhu nk’oku mumpunyire, na ngasi kanwa Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu akashuza, namumanyîsakwo, ntamufulike bici».
Nabo babwîra Yeremiyahu, erhi: Nyakasane ye rhulahîre, arhabêsha arhanarhebana, rhukabà rhurhajiziri nk’oku akanwa Nyakasane Nyamuzinda akurhuma warhubwîra kadesire.
Karhusîmîse karharhusîmîse, rhwakulikira izù lya Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wîrhu, ye rhukurhumirekwo na ntyo rhwanabà n’obusîme bw’okubà rhwakulikîre izù lya Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wîrhu.
Enyuma lya nsiku ikumi, akanwa ka Nyakasane karhindakwo Yeremiyahu.
Okubundi ahamagala Yohanâni, mugala wa Karea, n’abarhambo b’engabo z’abalwî bâli bo naye, ahamagala n’olubaga lwoshi, abarho n’abakulu.
Abà­ bwîra, erhi: Ntya kw’adesire Nyakasane Nyamuzinda w’Israheli, mwâli mu­ ntumire kuli ye mpu mmuhisekwo omusengero gwinyu.
Mukalonza okudêkerera mw’eci cihugo, namuyûbaka ntakanacimushâba, mmurhwêre ntakanacimushugula, bulya nâni ncîganyize okubî namujirire.
Murhayôbohaga oyu mwâmi w’e Babiloni murhinyire murhamuyôbohaga, ye kudesire Nyakasane, bulya ndi haguma ninyu nti mmucize nnâmulikûze omu nfune zâge.
Najira amufè bwonjo, obwonjo bwinyu bumugwârhe anamuleke mugaluke omu cihugo cinyu.
Cikwône erhi mwakaderha, mpu: rhurhalonza kubêra mw’eci cihugo, ago mango mulahire bwayumva izù lya Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu;
erhi mwakaderha, mpu: nanga, e Mîsiri yo rhulonzize okujà, yo rhurhâcibone ntambala, rhurhâciyumve mishekera yarhulâlika, rhurhâcibone eci cibula c’omugati, yo rhulonzize okubêra,
ago mango, musigala gwa Yûda, yumvi akanwa ka Nyakasane. Ntya kw’adesire, Nyakasane w’Emirhwe, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli. Erhi mwakahiga mpu yo mwaja e Mîsiri, mukà­nayijà mpu mubêreyo,
engôrho muyôbohire yamushanga eyo munda, omu cihugo ca Mîsiri; n’ecizombo murhînyire, camushimba lumino-mîno, eyo mu­nda e Mîsiri, yo mwanasigala!
N’abahizire mpu bajà e Mîsiri boshi, mpu yo bajibêra, yo banafira n’engôrho n’ecizombo n’ecihûsi, ntà muntu ciru n’omuguma wayîshifulumuka obuhanya-nabarhumira.

Nêci, ye kudesire Nyakasane w’Emirhwe, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli. Nka kulyâla omutula n’oburhè bwâni byadubukiraga oku bantu b’e Yeruzalemu, kwo n’omutula gwâni gwacîrhulira kuli mwe, mukajà e Mîsiri: mukola mwâbà bashombe, bamubôlwa, balya bahehêrîrwe, balya b’okushekerwa, murhakanacilolakwo eci cihugo.
Yere­miyahu ashuza, erhi: «Musigala gwa Yûda, Nyakasane yekubwîzire, erhi; orhafè e Mîsiri!» Omanyâge bwinjà oku kurhonda okwo namurhondaga ene.

Kucîgasha mwacîgashire erhi muntuma emunda Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu ali, erhi muderha, erhi: «orhusengerere emunda Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wîrhu ali, na ngasi kantu Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wîrhu akarhegeka, orhumanyîseko rhukakole».
N’ene namamumanyîsako, murhanayumvîrhe izù lya Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu, ci akanwa kaguma omu binwa antumire mpu mmubwîre.
Mumanyâge obwo oku mwâfà n’engôrho, n’ecizombo, n’ecahira, eyo munda mucifinjire okujà mpu yo mwajibêra.
